en: n. a device for slowing or stopping a vehicle; something that slows or stops something; a thick bush; v. to slow down or stop a vehicle by using a brake
ex: He put his foot on the brake to avoid the dog.
他踩下剎車避開那隻狗。

en: n. the quality of being willing to do something dangerous or difficult without showing fear; brave behavior
ex: The firefighter was awarded a medal for his bravery.
這位消防員因為英勇表現獲頒獎章。

en: n. a hard block of baked clay used for building walls; a toy building block; a. made of bricks; v. to build or fill with bricks
ex: The house is built of red brick.
這棟房子是用紅磚蓋的。

en: n. a woman who is getting married or has just got married
ex: The bride walked down the aisle in a white dress.
新娘穿著白紗走向紅毯。

en: n. a meal that you have in the late morning that is a combination of breakfast and lunch
ex: We met for brunch on Sunday at a new cafe.
我們週日在一間新咖啡館吃早午餐。

en: n. a round open container with a handle, used for carrying liquids; the amount that a bucket holds; (informal) a large amount; v. to carry in a bucket; (informal) to rain very heavily
ex: She filled a bucket with water from the well.
她用桶子從井裡裝水。

en: n. a plan for how to spend a particular amount of money; the amount of money available for a particular purpose; v. to plan how to spend money; a. cheap
ex: We need to stick to a tight budget this month.
這個月我們得嚴格遵守預算。

en: n. a large wild animal like a cow with large curved horns, found in Asia, Africa and North America; (US) a bison; v. to bully or confuse someone
ex: A herd of buffalo crossed the river.
一群水牛渡過河。

en: n. a meal in which people serve themselves from a table of dishes; a place in a station or hotel where food is served; a piece of furniture for holding dishes; v. to hit something repeatedly; (of wind or waves) to strike something forcefully
ex: The hotel serves a big breakfast buffet every morning.
飯店每天早上供應豐盛的自助早餐。

en: n. a glass ball that gives out light when electricity passes through it; a round part of a plant from which new plants grow; a round or swollen part of something
ex: The light bulb in the hallway needs to be replaced.
走廊的燈泡需要更換。

en: n. a male cow or other large male animal; (in finance) a person who expects share prices to rise; (informal) nonsense; the center of a target
ex: The bull charged at the man in the red shirt.
公牛衝向那個穿紅襯衫的男人。
ph: take the bull by the horns
a bull in a china shop

en: n. a small piece of metal that is fired from a gun; (informal) a short list item
ex: The bullet hit the wall and left a hole.
子彈打中牆壁並留下一個洞。

en: n. a number of things of the same type growing or fastened together; a group of people; (informal) a large number; v. to gather in a group
ex: He bought a bunch of flowers for his wife.
他買了一束花給太太。

en: n. a number of things tied or wrapped together; a large amount of money; a set of software or services sold together; v. to wrap things together; to push someone or something quickly into a place
ex: She carried a bundle of clothes down the stairs.
她抱著一捆衣服下樓。

en: to put a dead body into the ground; to hide something under the ground; to cover something completely; to hide something so that no one can find it
ex: The soldiers buried their friend near the river.
士兵們把朋友葬在河邊。
ph: bury one's head in the sand

en: n. a plant with many thin branches that is smaller than a tree; a large area of wild land; (the bush) a wild area in Australia
ex: A rabbit ran into the bush.
一隻兔子跑進了灌木叢。
ph: a bird in the hand is worth two in the bush
一鳥在手勝過二鳥在林

en: n. a low continuous sound like a bee; a sound made by a buzzer; gossip or excited talk; v. to make a low continuous sound; to be full of activity and talk; to call someone by pressing a buzzer
ex: I heard the buzz of insects in the garden.
我聽見花園裡有昆蟲的嗡嗡聲。

en: n. a thick strong wire or rope; a set of wires that carry electricity or signals; cable television; (old) a telegram sent by cable; v. to send a message by cable
ex: Plug the power cable into the socket.
把電源線插進插座。

en: n. a restaurant in a school, factory or office where people choose and pay for their own food; a place where people serve themselves
ex: We had lunch in the school cafeteria.
我們在學校餐廳吃午餐。

en: n. the land and buildings of a university, college or school; (US) university life
ex: Students walk across the campus to attend lectures.
學生們走過校園去上課。

en: n. the person in charge of a ship or aircraft; the leader of a sports team; a military officer of middle rank; v. to be the captain of a team or ship
ex: The captain of the ship ordered everyone to stay calm.
船長要求大家保持冷靜。

en: v. to take someone as a prisoner; to get control of a place; to record something in a photo or on film; to take someone's attention; n. the act of capturing something
ex: The photographer captured the beauty of the sunset.
攝影師捕捉了日落之美。

en: a. relaxed and informal; (of clothes) not formal; happening by chance; not serious or careful; (of work) not permanent; n. a person who works for only part of the time
ex: He wore casual clothes to the party.
他穿著休閒服去參加派對。

en: n. cows and bulls kept on a farm for their meat or milk; (plural) cows
ex: The farmer raises cattle on his ranch.
農夫在牧場上養牛。

en: n. a large natural hole in the side of a hill or under the ground; v. to fall in; to give up and agree to something after someone has pressured you
ex: Bats live in the dark cave.
蝙蝠住在黑暗的洞穴裡。

en: n. a person, team or animal that has won a competition; a person who strongly supports a cause; v. to support a cause or person strongly; a. winning
ex: She became the world champion at the age of nineteen.
她十九歲就成為世界冠軍。

en: n. a friendly informal talk; v. to talk in a friendly informal way; to communicate with someone over the internet
ex: We sat in the cafe and chatted for hours.
我們坐在咖啡館聊了好幾個小時。

en: n. a small round red or black fruit with a stone inside; a tree that produces this fruit; a bright red color
ex: She put a cherry on top of the cake.
她在蛋糕上放了一顆櫻桃。

en: n. the front part of the body between the neck and the stomach; a large strong box used for storing things; a piece of furniture with drawers
ex: He felt a sharp pain in his chest.
他感到胸口一陣刺痛。

en: a. cold enough to be unpleasant; (of a person) unfriendly; (of a place) uncomfortably cold
ex: It's a bit chilly in here; could you close the window?
這裡有點冷，可以請你關窗嗎？

en: n. a tall structure on a building through which smoke from a fire goes out; a glass tube around a lamp flame
ex: Smoke rose from the factory chimney.
工廠的煙囪冒出煙來。

en: n. the part of the face below the mouth; the front of the lower jaw
ex: He rested his chin on his hand and stared at the screen.
他用手托著下巴，盯著螢幕。

en: n. a small piece of something that has broken off; a thin slice of fried potato; a small piece of electronics used in computers; a flaw in something; v. to break a small piece off something; to hit a ball in a certain way
ex: She ate a bag of potato chips while watching TV.
她邊看電視邊吃了一包洋芋片。

en: v. to cut something into pieces with a knife or an ax; to cut food into small pieces; n. a piece of meat with a bone; a quick cutting blow; a stamp used to mark documents
ex: Please chop the onions into small pieces.
請把洋蔥切成小塊。

en: n. a thin roll of paper filled with cut tobacco that people smoke
ex: He lit a cigarette and looked out of the window.
他點了一根菸，望著窗外。

en: n. a traveling show with clowns, animals and acrobats; a large round open area surrounded by seats where a show takes place; (informal) a noisy confused situation
ex: The children laughed at the clowns at the circus.
孩子們看到馬戲團的小丑哈哈大笑。

en: n. a person who lives in a town or city; a person who has the legal right to belong to a country
ex: Every citizen has the right to vote.
每個公民都有投票權。

en: a. relating to the people of a country; polite and showing good manners; (of law) relating to the rights of private citizens; not belonging to the army or church
ex: The civil rights movement changed the country.
民權運動改變了這個國家。

en: n. a person whose job is to clean houses or offices; a substance used for cleaning; a dry cleaner
ex: The cleaner comes to the office every evening.
清潔工每晚都到辦公室來打掃。

en: n. a person who pays for services or advice from a professional person or organization; a customer; a person who is being served by a lawyer, bank or other professional
ex: The lawyer met with a new client this morning.
律師今天早上和一位新客戶見面。
